items.title: DeFranco Buddy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: yeah, we played some sessions together. And I believe we were on, there was one recording done, from a broadcast—a bootleg—with Stan and I.

ctx.x: So in ’49 and ’50 you had your fourth Metronome All-Stars with Lennie Tristano, Lee Konitz, Dizzy, Max Roach…
Oh, that’s right, Stan was on that one, yeah, great player, too.
